title: Uniform verification acceptance probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The uniform matrix product verification acceptance probability is the expectation, for a uniformly random $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, of $1$ when the matrix product verification predicate on $A,B,C',x$ holds and $0$ otherwise.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the matrix product verification predicate, so its exact condition cannot be given from this payload alone.
